verdict.rationale: Fern documents two official MCP servers. One is auto-generated and hosted for every docs site with Ask Fern, and connects clients like Claude Code, Cursor and Windsurf. The other is a private org-level Fern MCP server that coding agents register with to look up docs.yml syntax and read sites, deployments and reader activity. A probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, detailed setup/auth and tool-list documentation in the evidence.
